SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to}) AS order_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE picked_up_at >= #{from} AND picked_up_at < #{to}) AS completed_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE canceled_at >= #{from} AND canceled_at < #{to}) AS canceled_count, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(final_amount), 0) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to}) AS order_amount
SELECT AS label, COUNT(*) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(final_amount), 0) AS order_amount FROM orders WHERE created_at >= #{from} AND created_at < #{to} GROUP BY ORDER BY MIN(created_at)

SELECT oi.product_id AS product_id, MAX(oi.product_name) AS product_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS quantity, COALESCE(SUM(oi.total_amount), 0) AS order_amount FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.created_at >= #{from} AND o.created_at < #{to} AND o.status NOT IN ('CANCELED', 'REJECTED') GROUP BY oi.product_id ORDER BY quantity DESC, order_amount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
